breakdown.description: The local normal traction on the hypotenuse is replaced by a global vertical vector
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly resolved the conflicting instructions regarding the load on the hypotenuse. The incomplete prompt incorrectly stated to apply the load as a fixed vertical vector. The agent's generated specification correctly describes it as an 'upward normal traction', which aligns with the ground truth's clarification to interpret the load in the local boundary-normal direction.
